**Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium** is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient facility operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. In the context of the national ADHD quality database, which tracks the systemic challenges and diagnostic standards of ADHD assessments across the Danish healthcare system, Aabenraa stands out as a significant positive outlier and a potential model of good practice for other departments.

While the broader Danish psychiatric system faces a systemic crisis—with most national process indicators falling far below the required 90% standard due to resource constraints, geographical barriers, and inconsistent clinical practices—Aabenraa has demonstrated exceptional compliance. Notably, it is the only facility in the entire database that successfully meets the standard for [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]], achieving a 90% compliance rate (95% CI: 86–93) based on 286 assessment pathways [^src1] [^src4]. This makes it a unique benchmark for foundational ADHD diagnostic requirements in the country.

The facility's high performance extends to other critical diagnostic metrics. For [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]], which measures the use of clinical environmental observation for children aged 0–5 within 120 days of starting an ADHD assessment, Aabenraa achieved a 100% fulfillment rate [^src4]. It was one of only two departments in the country, alongside [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]], to reach the development goal for this indicator [^src3]. 

Furthermore, Aabenraa excelled in [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]], which tracks the use of manualized diagnostic interviews or environmental observations for children and adolescents aged 6–17. While the national fulfillment for this indicator languished at a mere 48%, Aabenraa achieved a 93% fulfillment rate in the 2024 report [^src3], and a similarly strong 89% (95% CI: 84–92) in the 2023/24 reporting period [^src5]. By consistently meeting or approaching the ≥90% targets across multiple age groups and diagnostic methodologies, Aabenraa provides a rare example of evidence-based, high-quality diagnostic practice in a system otherwise struggling with implementation and capacity issues.

  - Der er to afdelinger der nåede udviklingsmålet for Indikator 2a: PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Vejle) og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) begge med 100 % opfyldelse [^src1]
